risks.summary: Remote main currently has no verified required-check ruleset receipt.
risks.mitigation: Create and independently verify the required-check ruleset, then bind its authenticated receipt to the exact release candidate SHA.
risks.release_effect: Blocks release-candidate PASS; it does not block local verification work.

risks.summary: The first backup/restore drill uses disposable synthetic data rather than the existing user-data source.
risks.mitigation: Run the same non-destructive drill against an approved encrypted backup of the authoritative data before production release.
risks.release_effect: Requires explicit owner review and a production-data-class restore receipt.

risks.summary: Production scheduler, alert delivery and key escrow have not been exercised in the local environment.
risks.mitigation: Capture provider-side scheduler, alert-delivery and key-access receipts in the deployment environment.
risks.release_effect: Local fixture evidence cannot satisfy the production operations gate.

risks.summary: API, ingestion and outbox SLO targets are not yet bound to a measured first baseline and alert delivery receipt.
risks.mitigation: Capture the content-free baseline, activate the policy with its receipt hash, and verify an actionable test alert reaches the declared on-call escalation target.
risks.release_effect: Blocks release-candidate PASS; provisional numeric targets are not operational evidence.
